about: Every tunable limit and default in g1-lab. Change a value here and nothing else. 'source' says where the number came from: robot (a fact of the hardware or SDK), user (your decision), gpt-policy (copied from the reference repo), measured (checked by running it), repo (in the repo before the agent work), guess (chosen without evidence: review these first). Print this table with: python -m limits

control_dt_s.note: the control tick: arm_sdk is published at 50 Hz

record_step_s.note: a step record (frame + joints) is closed this often while a skill runs

base_vx_max.note: hard ceiling on forward base speed; Unitree's high-level examples cap at 0.3

base_vy_max.note: hard ceiling on sideways base speed; never tested on the robot

base_vyaw_max.note: hard ceiling on base turn rate; never tested on the robot

walk_speed.note: speed move and walk_forward translate at; must stay under base_vx_max

side_speed.note: speed move sidesteps at; must stay under base_vy_max; never run on the robot

turn_rate.note: rate move and turn rotate at; must stay under base_vyaw_max

min_segment_s.note: shortest base segment, so a held waist is never recentred faster than this

joint_margin_rad.note: how far inside the joint limits a measured or commanded angle must stay

command_vel_max.note: fastest the commanded joint angle may change between ticks

max_violations.note: a sim run stops after this many monitor violations

move_dx_max_m.note: furthest forward or back one move (or walk_forward) may go; you asked for room-crossing moves

move_dy_max_m.note: furthest sideways one move may go

move_dyaw_max_deg.note: largest turn in one move (or turn)

look_yaw_max_deg.note: largest waist turn of the look preset

arm_path_seconds_min.note: shortest time for one arm_path waypoint

arm_path_seconds_max.note: longest time for one arm_path waypoint

arm_path_seconds_default.note: time for a waypoint that names none

wave_hand_seconds.note: how long the arms stay with the onboard controller for WaveHand; time the real gesture and correct this

shake_hand_seconds.note: the same for ShakeHand; time the real gesture and correct this

gesture_seconds_max.note: longest the model may ask an onboard gesture to take

gesture_ramp_s.note: weight ramp before and after an onboard gesture

bookend_ramp_s.note: takeover and handback: the arm_sdk weight ramp

bookend_to_stand_s.note: takeover and handback: the move to the stand pose

return_to_stand_s.note: safe return after Ctrl-C, --max-time or an error: the move to the stand pose

return_ramp_s.note: safe return: the weight fade to 0

return_released_s.note: safe return: the final hold at exactly weight 0

max_decisions.note: model decisions per run, rejected replies included (gpt-policy uses 100)

step_timeout_s.note: longest wait for one decision before the run fails

max_time_s.note: longest a policy may run before the runner stops it (raise it for search)

settle_min_s.note: shortest stand-still before a frame is taken, so StopMove has landed

settle_pos_tol_rad.note: settled when every commanded joint is this close to its command; tuned for their arm, sim arms reach 0.019

settle_vel_tol.note: settled when every commanded joint is slower than this

settle_samples.note: consecutive ticks inside both tolerances to count as settled

settle_timeout_s.note: give up waiting to settle, and report settled=false

frame_max_age_s.note: oldest camera frame a decision may be made on

frame_timeout_s.note: longest wait for a fresh frame before deciding without one

max_failures.note: consecutive missing frames that end the run

max_tokens.note: reply budget, reasoning included; 400 cut a reasoning model off before it answered (a decision used 446). A ceiling, not a cost

request_timeout_s.note: longest one HTTP request to the model may take

image_width_px.note: frames are downscaled to this width before they are sent

jpeg_quality.note: JPEG quality of frames sent to the model (records stay lossless PNG)

live_image_window.note: observation images kept in the conversation; older turns keep their text

retry_max.note: retries when the model is overloaded

retry_delay_base_s.note: first retry delay; doubles each time

recovery_timeout_s.note: total time allowed for retries before the run fails

states_hz.note: rate the measured joint state is logged at (gpt-policy logs at 50)

video_fps.note: candidate frames sampled from a demonstration video

video_window_s.note: window the keyframe selector looks at in one call

video_keyframes_per_window.note: most keyframes the selector may pick per window
